description:
Error Code Format: [CATEGORY][NUMBER]
Categories:
LEX - Lexer Errors
SYN - Syntax Errors (Parser)
RUN - Runtime Errors
ASN - Assignment Errors
MOD - Modification Errors
CMP - Comparison Errors
IMP - Import Errors
MTH - Math Errors
SHD - Shadowing Errors
WRN - Warnings
